description: Issue link and unlink History rows read 'Maya Okafor recorded task.link-issue on this task' / 'recorded task.unlink-issue'. That is the raw operation type, with no repository or issue number.
expected: 'Maya Okafor linked acme/lantern-checkout#418' / 'Theo Lindqvist unlinked acme/lantern-checkout#481'
suggested_fix: Add task.link-issue and task.unlink-issue cases to describeEvent, using the payload's repository and number.

description: Server-side rejections of an issue reference (#0, characters outside the allowed set) appear at the panel top with 'Your last confirmed data remains available.' and Dismiss, away from the field. Client-side format errors appear inline under the field, so the same form uses two error styles.
expected: All issue-reference errors appear inline under the Link GitHub issue field.
actual: Server errors at the panel top
suggested_fix: Add task.link-issue to FORM_SLOTS, or mirror the server rules (positive number, repository charset) in the UI regex.

description: A pasted GitHub issue URL (https://github.com/acme/lantern-checkout/issues/418) is rejected with the format error, although it holds exactly the needed data.
expected: URLs are accepted and normalised to owner/repo#number.
suggested_fix: Parse github.com/<owner>/<repo>/(issues|pull)/<n> URLs in the input handler.

description: After a successful Link issue the field clears, the button disables, and focus falls to document.body.
expected: Focus returns to the Link GitHub issue field (or the new link).
suggested_fix: Refocus the input after a successful link.
